series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): Light Yagami touches the seized Death Note to regain his Kira memories and executes Higuchi to permanently retain ownership.
Prior events (Part 2): The task force discovers the fake thirteen-day rule and clears Light and Misa of suspicion, allowing Light to have his handcuffs removed before sending Misa to unearth the hidden Death Note and trade half her lifespan to Ryuk for Shinigami eyes.
